identity.name: Edge-VPN Probing Surge Attributed to a TIM Scanning-Infra Feed as a CVE-2026-0257 Exploit Precursor (T1595 / T1590 / T1133)
identity.summary: A TIM feed flags a source IP/ASN as CVE-2026-0257 GlobalProtect scanning infrastructure; Cortex ASM and the NGFW record that same IP mass-probing the exposed portal, where few probes establish a session. A correlation joins the feed match and the probing surge on source IP, asserting recon preceded any auth-bypass on the matched edge asset — an attributed exploit precursor.
identity.description: During the active exploitation of CVE-2026-0257 (a GlobalProtect portal/gateway authentication bypass in PAN-OS), Unit 42 observed a wide-sweep reconnaissance phase from a small set of source IPs before the public PoC dropped: mass probing of internet-exposed GlobalProtect portals where only a small portion of the probed devices actually established VPN sessions (gateway-connected events). In isolation each inbound prelogin probe is low signal — indistinguishable from benign VPN-client discovery — so a single-signal detector under-alerts on it. This scenario proves the Cortex differentiator: cross-source correlation. Three independent facts are stitched on the shared source IP within a window: (1) a Threat Intel Management feed lists the source IP/ASN as adversary scanning infrastructure tied to CVE-2026-0257; (2) Cortex ASM/Xpanse has the org's exposed GlobalProtect portal in its attack-surface inventory as an internet-exposed VPN edge asset; (3) the NGFW records a probing surge from that same source against the portal's unauthenticated prelogin endpoints, with an anomalously low probe-to-session ratio (wide sweep, few connects). The terminal correlation (CR-TIM-0006) joins the feed match to the NGFW portal-probing surge on source IP, asserts the reconnaissance temporally precedes the first gateway-connected event on the matched edge asset, and raises ONE attributed exploit-precursor incident. The POV thesis: a feed hit alone is noise, a probe alone is noise, an exposure finding alone is a to-do item — the platform is what fuses all three into an attributed, actionable precursor that lets the SOC pre-empt the auth-bypass rather than triage it after a session is established. Detections are weighted to the correlation terminal: the TIM attribution query and the portal-probing-surge BIOC are the joined legs, the probe-to-session ratio query is the behavioral anomaly, the ASM query supplies the matched edge asset, and the stitch-validation query confirms the enriched join fired.

execution.framework_reference_id: SIM-TIM-006 — TIM-attributed GlobalProtect probing surge as a CVE-2026-0257 exploit precursor (recon-to-exploit cross-source correlation).

prerequisites.description: The TIM feed (mocktaxii / threat_intel) is subscribed and carries the CVE-2026-0257 GlobalProtect scanning-infrastructure indicators tagged as adversary scanning infrastructure.

An authorised lab GlobalProtect portal (or NGFW GlobalProtect log source) is reachable so inbound prelogin probing produces panw_ngfw_globalprotect_raw telemetry, and Cortex ASM has the exposed portal in its inventory.

payload.code:
# SAFE-MODE recon simulation: probe the AUTHORISED lab GlobalProtect portal's
# unauthenticated prelogin endpoints to reproduce the CVE-2026-0257 pre-exploit
# scanning surge (wide sweep, few sessions). NO authentication-bypass exploit is
# attempted — this generates RECON signal only so the TIM feed match, the NGFW
# portal-probing surge, and the ASM edge-asset finding can be correlated.
set -euo pipefail
PORTAL="${PORTAL_HOST:-gp-portal.lab.local}"
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  curl -sk --max-time 5 "https://${PORTAL}/global-protect/prelogin.esp" -o /dev/null 2>/dev/null || true
  curl -sk --max-time 5 "https://${PORTAL}/ssl-vpn/prelogin.esp" -o /dev/null 2>/dev/null || true
done
echo "[CortexSim] SIM-TIM-006 GlobalProtect prelogin probing surge complete (recon only, no exploit)."

input_variables.name: PORTAL_HOST
input_variables.description: Authorised lab GlobalProtect portal the recon probing surge targets.

expected_artifacts.description: A burst of inbound HTTPS requests to the GlobalProtect unauthenticated prelogin endpoints (/global-protect/prelogin.esp, /ssl-vpn/prelogin.esp) from a single source, with an anomalously low probe-to-session ratio.
The probing source IP matches a TIM threat_intel indicator tagged as CVE-2026-0257 GlobalProtect scanning infrastructure.

cleanup.code: echo '[CortexSim] SIM-TIM-006 cleanup complete — no persistent artifacts (read-only recon probing).'

biocs.name: GlobalProtect Portal Probing Surge From a Single Source
biocs.description: A single source IP mass-probes the unauthenticated GlobalProtect prelogin/login endpoints on the exposed portal in a short burst — the wide-sweep reconnaissance shape Unit 42 observed ahead of CVE-2026-0257 exploitation. Rate-bounded: keys on >=50 prelogin requests from one source within a 10-minute bucket AND a low probe-to-session ratio (<=2 gateway-connected sessions), so busy-but-benign NAT/CGNAT egress that establishes real sessions is excluded rather than raised as a chronic false positive.
biocs.logic:
dataset = panw_ngfw_globalprotect_raw
| filter log_subtype = "globalprotect"
| filter request_path in ("/global-protect/prelogin.esp", "/ssl-vpn/prelogin.esp", "/global-protect/login.esp")
| bin _time span=10m
| alter is_connected = if(event_type = "gateway-connected", 1, 0)
| comp count() as portal_probes, sum(is_connected) as connected_sessions, count_distinct(request_path) as distinct_paths by source_ip, dst_host, _time
| filter portal_probes >= 50 and connected_sessions <= 2
| sort desc portal_probes
| fields source_ip, dst_host, _time, portal_probes, connected_sessions, distinct_paths

xql_queries.name: TIM Feed Attribution — GlobalProtect Scanning Infrastructure Match
xql_queries.query:
dataset = threat_intel
| filter indicator_type = "ipv4"
| filter feed_source = "scanning-infrastructure"
| filter tags contains "globalprotect-scanner" or tags contains "cve-2026-0257"
| comp count() as flagged_hits by indicator_value, asn
| filter flagged_hits >= 1
| fields indicator_value, asn, flagged_hits

xql_queries.name: GlobalProtect Probe-to-Session Ratio Anomaly
xql_queries.query:
dataset = panw_ngfw_globalprotect_raw
| filter log_subtype = "globalprotect"
| bin _time span=10m
| alter is_connected = if(event_type = "gateway-connected", 1, 0)
| comp count() as portal_events, sum(is_connected) as connected_sessions by source_ip, _time
| filter portal_events >= 50 and connected_sessions <= 2
| sort desc portal_events
| fields source_ip, _time, portal_events, connected_sessions

xql_queries.name: Cortex ASM Exposed GlobalProtect Portal Edge Asset
xql_queries.query:
dataset = asm_findings
| filter service_name = "globalprotect-portal" or service_port = 443
| filter finding_type = "internet-exposed-vpn-portal"
| comp count() as exposures by asset_name, asset_ip
| filter exposures >= 1
| fields asset_name, asset_ip, exposures

xql_queries.name: Recon-to-Exploit Precursor Stitch Validation
xql_queries.query:
dataset = network_story
| filter dst_port = 443 and app = "panos-global-protect"
| filter ti_category = "scanning-infrastructure"
| bin _time span=10m
| comp count() as probe_sessions, min(_time) as first_probe, max(_time) as last_probe by source_ip, dst_host, _time
| filter probe_sessions >= 50
| fields source_ip, dst_host, probe_sessions, first_probe, last_probe

correlation_rules.name: TIM-Attributed GlobalProtect Recon-to-Exploit Precursor
correlation_rules.logic: XQL(TIM Feed Attribution — GlobalProtect Scanning Infrastructure Match) AND BIOC(GlobalProtect Portal Probing Surge From a Single Source) share the same source_ip within a 3600s window AND the NGFW portal-probing surge precedes the first gateway-connected event on the matched exposed GlobalProtect edge asset — stitches the low-signal probe into one attributed exploit-precursor incident asserting reconnaissance preceded the CVE-2026-0257 authentication-bypass attempt.

threat_scenarios.name: TIM-Attributed Edge-VPN Recon-to-Exploit Precursor Correlation
threat_scenarios.description: Cortex fuses a Threat Intel Management feed hit (source IP flagged as CVE-2026-0257 GlobalProtect scanning infrastructure), the NGFW GlobalProtect portal-probing surge from that same source, and the Cortex ASM exposed-portal edge-asset inventory into one attributed exploit-precursor incident — turning a low-signal probe into an actionable, pre-exploit alert the SOC can act on before a VPN session is established.

threat_steps.objective: The correlation raises one attributed exploit-precursor incident when the TIM feed match and the GlobalProtect portal-probing surge share a source IP within the window.
preconditions: TIM feed carries the CVE-2026-0257 GlobalProtect scanning-infrastructure indicators.
An authorised GlobalProtect portal log source and the ASM exposed-portal finding are present.
steps: Confirm the TIM feed lists the scanning-infrastructure source IPs.
Generate the GlobalProtect prelogin probing surge from a flagged source.
Observe CR-TIM-0006 stitch the feed match and portal-probing surge into one incident.
success_criteria: XQL `TIM Feed Attribution — GlobalProtect Scanning Infrastructure Match` returns the flagged source IP.
BIOC `GlobalProtect Portal Probing Surge From a Single Source` fires.
Correlation CR-TIM-0006 raises exactly one attributed exploit-precursor incident joining TIM + ASM + NDR on source IP.

threat_steps.objective: The probe-to-session ratio anomaly surfaces the wide-sweep/low-connect shape of the reconnaissance.
steps: Run the probing surge with only a small fraction of probes establishing gateway-connected sessions.
Run the GlobalProtect Probe-to-Session Ratio Anomaly query.
success_criteria: XQL `GlobalProtect Probe-to-Session Ratio Anomaly` returns the source with portal_events >= 50 and connected_sessions <= 2.

threat_steps.objective: The matched edge asset is the org's exposed GlobalProtect portal in the Cortex ASM inventory.
preconditions: Cortex ASM has discovered the internet-exposed GlobalProtect portal.
steps: Run the Cortex ASM Exposed GlobalProtect Portal Edge Asset query.
success_criteria: XQL `Cortex ASM Exposed GlobalProtect Portal Edge Asset` returns the exposed portal asset the correlation matched on.

preventive_controls: Patch PAN-OS to a fixed release for CVE-2026-0257 and restrict GlobalProtect portal/gateway exposure to required source ranges or a ZTNA broker rather than the open internet.
Block or challenge inbound connections from source IPs/ASNs a TIM feed flags as active scanning infrastructure at the NGFW before they reach the portal.
Reduce the attack surface Cortex ASM/Xpanse reports for internet-exposed VPN portals; require MFA and device posture for any GlobalProtect gateway connection.
detection_engineering: Enrich NGFW GlobalProtect portal telemetry with the TIM scanning-infrastructure feed at ingest so a feed-flagged source probing the portal is high-fidelity from the first event.
Alert on a probe-to-session ratio anomaly (many prelogin probes from one source, few gateway-connected sessions) as the pre-exploit reconnaissance signature.

Correlate the TIM feed match, the NGFW portal-probing surge, and the ASM exposed-portal finding on source IP so the recon is raised as an attributed exploit precursor, not three disconnected low-signal events.
